title: Auto Crop Replant
description: A simple plugin that replants your crops.
body:
# Auto Crop Replant

With this plugin you can replant your crops in a way that you probably never thinked before, non manual crop harvesting! Thats right with this plugin you can replant your crops that have been harvested by eg. pouring water on it, so this means you dont have to harvest the crops with a tool to auto replant it!

## The features of the plugin

Auto crop replant comes with multiple levels of automation.

Level | Replant Radius | Replants Crops  |
------|----------------|----------------|
Level **1** | **8 Blocks**   | **15 Seconds** |
Level **2** | **12 Blocks**  | **10 Seconds** |
Level **3** | **16 Blocks**  | **8 Seconds**  |
Level **4** | **20 Blocks**  | **5 Seconds**  |
Level **5** | **24 Blocks**  | **4 Seconds**  |
Level **6** | **28 Blocks**  | **3 Seconds**  |

## How to install

1. Just download the plugin file.
2. Put it into your ``plugins`` folder.
3. Start your server.
